mapper.sql: p.id, p.user_id, p.node_type, p.title, p.stage, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.workdays, p.notice_text, p.objection_channel, p.status, p.result, p.published_at, p.closed_at, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.username) AS user_name, u.student_id AS student_no
FROM party_publicity p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = p.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO party_publicity (user_id, node_type, title, stage, start_date, end_date, workdays, notice_text, objection_channel, status, result, published_at, closed_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nodeType}, #{title}, #{stage}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{workdays}, #{noticeText}, #{objectionChannel}, #{status}, #{result}, #{publishedAt}, #{closedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE party_publicity SET node_type = #{publicity.nodeType}, title = #{publicity.title}, stage = #{publicity.stage}, user_id = #{publicity.userId}, start_date = #{publicity.startDate}, end_date = #{publicity.endDate}, workdays = #{publicity.workdays}, notice_text = #{publicity.noticeText}, objection_channel = #{publicity.objectionChannel}, status = #{publicity.status}, result = #{publicity.result}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{publicity.id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE party_publicity SET status = 'publicizing', published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE party_publicity SET status = 'closed', result = #{result}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{fromStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT p.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_publicity p WHERE p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY p.status
SELECT p.node_type AS node_type, COUNT(*) AS total FROM party_publicity p WHERE p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.node_type ORDER BY p.node_type
